Found old conversion of html to markdown

Committing as-is
Propagate XML errors to exceptions properly
Add support for "is"-prefixed javabean-style properties

Update docs to add for/join
Remove extra debugging
Add mod operator
Build a better standalone jar using ProGuard to trim unused Guava stuff

Update ant for maven paths
Convert Eclipse project to a maven-managed one

Adding arthurkalm's pom
Ignore maven target
Ignore ant targets
Remove references to jars that no longer exist
Prepare for maven
Preparing for maven
Improve comments.
Rolling TemplateFileSourceInfo and ParentSourceInfo into one.
Refactoring to remove TemplateSource
More minor cleanups

Rename TemplateTreeBuilder
Clean up TemplateBuilder unused method
Clean up imports and extra lines in test files
Removing Templater: TemplateFactory is now the only way to create templates
Move to docs
Opcode2 -> Opcode
Instruction2 -> Instruction

Removing commons-io and commons-lang deps (these functions are available in Guava)
Adding some additional tests
Need to move Java project files too
Move README.md to root
Moving the java project to a subdir so we can add the web project in here too.
Removing public/internal test dichotomy.
Note that we support Android

Rewriting the ArrayUtils class, removing stuff that should be
available on Android.
Adding tests for ArrayUtils in preparation to rewrite them
Removing unused asList

Moving test support for direct ANTLR test inside the JAR so we can
eliminate the public/internal test dichotomy.
Adding some code docs for the xml package.
Moving some docs into a todo/ folder so they don't confuse people.
Remove Java-1.7ism
Adding a basic README.md
Adding license
